instrument_owed.owes: an arm in `tests/test-board-clock-power.js` that stands a weather setter beside a partner of the boosted type with that weather ALREADY UP and FAILS while the feature still reads 1. `engine/feature_shift.js` is the instrument that would size it **CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT 2026-08-18 BY MEASURE — THE DEFECT IS STILL LIVE AND THE CHEAP GATE FOR IT IS UNSAFE.** Swept the live tree: `__weather` occurs **exactly once outside `data/releases/`** — the read at `engine/board.js:483` — with **265 further occurrences, every one the same line copied into a frozen release**, and **ZERO assignments anywhere**. So the guard evaluates as `'' !== w`, true for every non-empty `w`, and it has never bound. A second defect is visible in the same three lines and is recorded rather than fixed: the loop runs `[[A, B], [B, A]]` and reads `A.__weather` in BOTH passes, so even a populated field would ask about the wrong candidate. **THE OBVIOUS GATE WAS BUILT, MEASURED AND REJECTED**: a general static scan for `__`-prefixed fields read and never assigned fires on **8 fields in `engine/`** and only ONE of them is this defect — `__ABRA_DEX`, `__seed`, `__setDB`, `__unreadable`, `__ally`, `__onSetDB` and `__ABRA_BOARD_DATA` are all assigned through forms the scan cannot see. Seven false positives out of eight is a ratchet people learn to ignore, which is the failure this repository names by its own casualties, so it is NOT shipped. INSTRUMENT OWED, unchanged and now with the alternative ruled out: the FUNCTIONAL arm this row already specifies — stand a weather setter beside a partner of the boosted type with that weather ALREADY UP and FAIL while the feature still reads 1. A static scan cannot substitute for it
